events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Pedrola, per the article lead dates.
Married Luisa de Borja y Aragón.

evidence.quote: Martín remarried around 1542 to Luisa de Borja y Aragón
In 1542 married Luisa de Borja y Aragón

events.text: Inherited the title of Count of Ribagorza on his father's death.

evidence.quote: He inherited the title of Count of Ribagorza on his fathers death in 1550

events.text: Zamora court took County rights, rents and castles from him.

evidence.quote: On 6 June 1554 a court in Zamora took rights , rents and castles of the County out of Martíns hands

events.label: court
events.text: Accompanied Philip to Brussels to witness Charles V's abdication.

evidence.quote: Charles Vs abdication of his rule over the Low Countries

events.label: military
events.text: Distinguished himself at the battle of St Quentin, gaining royal favour.

evidence.quote: In 1557 , Martín distinguished himself in the battle of St Quentin
He also became 4th Duke of Villahermosa in 1558

events.text: Wife Luisa de Borja died; he left court to govern Aragon estates.

evidence.quote: he had to leave court to govern his possessions in Aragon after his wifes death in 1560
The duke married a third time after her death

events.text: Passed County of Ribagorza to his eldest son Juan.

evidence.quote: On 6 May 1565 he passed the County of Ribagorza to his eldest son Juan de Gurrea y Aragón

events.text: Married María Pérez de Pomar, his third marriage.

evidence.quote: The duke married a third time after her death , to María Pérez de Pomar in 1566
he remarried to María Pérez de Pomar

events.text: Lawsuit to regain control of the County of Ribagorza succeeded.

evidence.quote: which eventually proved successful on 18 May 1567

events.text: Duchy of Villahermosa, County of Ribagorza and other titles inherited by son Fernando

evidence.quote: finally dying in 1581 . The Duchy of Villahermosa , County of Ribagorza and his other titles were inherited by his son Fernando

events.label: death
events.text: Died in Pedrola, after increasing religious devotion.

undated_mentions: Educated in Santiago de Compostela by uncle cardinal Pedro Gómez Sarmiento (no date)
Served as minstrel to Empress Isabel of Portugal (no date)
Served as page of the future Philip II of Spain (no date)
Accompanied Philip to England for his marriage to Mary I (no date)
Took his case to the Justiciar of Aragon (no date)
Re-assumed responsibility for County of Ribagorza after son's execution (after 1573, no exact date)
Wrote Discursos sobre medallas y antigüedades (no date)
Left his art and coin collection to Pedrola and Monastery of Veruela at death (no exact date)
Death of his mother (final years, no date)
